offer.intro: 村外的史莱姆越来越多了。年轻的冒险者，愿意帮我们清理三处巢穴吗？
offer.accepted: 多谢。三处巢穴都在村庄郊外，清理后回来找我。
offer.declined: 没关系。准备好后再来找我。

active.reminder: 郊外还有史莱姆巢穴。小心一些，累了就回来整备。

turnin.thanks: 你真的清理了所有巢穴！这是村里答应给你的报酬。
turnin.claimed: 愿你的剑继续守护这片土地。
turnin.deferred: 报酬会替你保管，想领取时再来。

completed.thanks: 村外安静多了。大家都记得你的帮助。

arrival.intro: 雾气越过林梢，远处传来巡守的号角。这里的每一步都可能惊动潜伏的魔物。
arrival.warning: 跟紧我。若有人受伤，我会优先救治队伍中最危险的同伴。

offer.intro: 我在雾林深处遗失了一箱补给。能帮我把它找回来吗？
offer.accepted: 物资箱在林地东北侧。找到后带着箱上的封条回来。
offer.declined: 雾气正浓，准备妥当再来也好。

active.reminder: 沿林地北侧走，物资箱应该还在那里。

turnin.thanks: 封条还在，太好了。这份报酬请收下。
turnin.claimed: 有你这样的冒险者，雾林会安全许多。
turnin.deferred: 不着急，报酬会替你留着。

completed.thanks: 补给已经送回巡守营地，多谢你的帮助。

offer.intro: Slimes are overrunning the outskirts. Will you clear their three nests, young adventurer?
offer.accepted: Thank you. All three nests are outside the village. Return when they are cleared.
offer.declined: That is all right. Come back when you are ready.

active.reminder: Slime nests remain outside. Be careful, and return here if you need to recover.

turnin.thanks: You cleared every nest! Here is the reward the village promised.
turnin.claimed: May your sword continue to protect this land.
turnin.deferred: There is no hurry. I will keep the reward for you.

completed.thanks: The outskirts are quiet again. Everyone remembers what you did.

arrival.intro: Mist rolls over the canopy, and a ranger's horn sounds in the distance. Every step may wake a lurking beast.
arrival.warning: Stay close. If anyone is hurt, I will tend to the ally in greatest danger first.

offer.intro: I lost a supply crate deep in the Mistwood. Can you recover it?
offer.accepted: The crate is in the northeast grove. Bring back the seal attached to it.
offer.declined: The mist is thick. It is wise to prepare before you go.

active.reminder: Follow the northern edge of the grove. The supply crate should still be there.

turnin.thanks: The seal is intact. Wonderful. Please take this reward.
turnin.claimed: With adventurers like you, the Mistwood will be safer.
turnin.deferred: No hurry. I will keep the reward for you.

completed.thanks: The supplies reached the ranger camp. Thank you for your help.
